questions.question: What is the total addressable memory space of the Intel 8085 microprocessor?
questions.explanation: The Intel 8085 has a 16-bit address bus (A0-A15). Therefore, it can address 2^16 = 65,536 bytes = 64 KB of memory space.

questions.question: If the Code Segment (CS) register contains 2000H and the Instruction Pointer (IP) contains 1050H, what is the calculated physical memory address in the 8086?
Which 8085 interrupt line is non-maskable and has the highest priority?
questions.explanation: TRAP is the only Non-Maskable Interrupt (NMI) in the 8085. It has the highest priority and is triggered by both a rising edge and a high level.

questions.question: How many 8-bit parallel I/O ports are integrated on a standard 8051 microcontroller chip?
questions.explanation: The standard 8051 microcontroller contains 4 8-bit I/O ports named P0, P1, P2, and P3, giving a total of 32 I/O pins.

questions.question: Calculate the TH1 reload value in Hex for generating a 9600 baud rate in an 8051 microcontroller using an 11.0592 MHz crystal (SMOD = 0).
questions.explanation: Machine Clock = 11.0592 MHz / 12 = 921.6 kHz. Timer 1 Clock = 921.6 kHz / 32 = 28.8 kHz. For 9600 baud, count required = 28800 / 9600 = 3. Therefore TH1 = 256 - 3 = 253 = 0xFD.

questions.question: Which feature enables ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers to achieve high code density while executing 32-bit instructions?
questions.explanation: Thumb-2 technology allows 16-bit and 32-bit instructions to be intermixed seamlessly without switching processor states, offering up to 30% higher code density.
